datasets.name: FFHQ
datasets.prompt: a photo of a closed face
datasets.provenance: Existing 00000.png–00999.png. Authors did not release exact subset IDs; verify equivalence before claiming a numerical match.

datasets.name: DIV2K
datasets.provenance: Existing 0001.png–0800.png; DAPE captions must be joined by filename, not line order.

datasets.name: AFHQ
datasets.provenance: Original StarGAN-v2 AFHQ validation cats and dogs, 500 per class. This 1000-image composition is inferred from the paper's dog/cat prompts; authors did not release subset IDs.

unreported_settings.eta_x: fixed public code values; paper omits them
unreported_settings.eta_z: 0.01 squared-sum objective with Armijo backtracking; paper omits it
unreported_settings.subset_ids: FFHQ first 1000, AFHQ val cats+dogs, DIV2K training800; exact author subset unpublished
unreported_settings.metric: primary author eval.py VGG224[0,1]; secondary standard LPIPS VGG768[-1,1]
unreported_settings.vae: paper SD3 backbone interpreted as complete original SD3 pipeline
unreported_settings.baseline_cfg: B.2 conventional guidance2; HDPS follows literal Eq6 lambda2
unreported_settings.gaussian_operator: published SVD discretization retained; no retuning of blur implementation
unreported_settings.step0: completed model/manifest initialization; subsequent steps count actual sampling outer iterations
